parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Carry out a relevant method to obtain $A$ and $B$ such that $\frac1{x(2x+3)}\equiv\frac Ax+\frac B{2x+3}$, or equivalent. M1
Obtain $A=\frac13$ and $B=-\frac23$, or equivalent. A1
Total [2]

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Separate variables and integrate one side. B1
Obtain term $\ln y$. B1
Integrate and obtain terms $\frac13\ln x-\frac13\ln(2x+3)$, or equivalent. B2 FT
Use $x=1$ and $y=1$ to evaluate a constant, or as limits, in a solution containing $a\ln y$, $b\ln x$, $c\ln(2x+3)$. M1
Obtain correct solution in any form, e.g. $\ln y=\frac13\ln x-\frac13\ln(2x+3)+\frac13\ln5$. A1
Obtain answer $y=1.29$ (3 s.f. only). A1
Total [7]
